gov_personnel.name: Penny Johnson, Anthony Purkey, Amber Vaughn

data.leadership_messages: CAs are not properly aligned to restructure for Product Support activities (PS) or even some of the Integration. I have elements aligned to me that are not in my AOR. a. Activities Technical Orders, Supply Support, PHS&T should be broken out per AOR. b. The Product PSIs should be the oversight manager of PS activities or his/her Product. The Integration PS person should be only enabling the efforts to happen and take the product upon CDR completion to build the PS package.

data.questions: Supportability is high risk, but the risk posture is consistent with the rest of the program to meet IOC in 2033 (e.g. schedule is success oriented – no margin for test failure or redesign work, concurrent development may drive design changes or rework, etc.). Without accurate data and design going fast approach could cause significate throughput for parts procurement in the future. A lot of moving parts with the agile approach on a program of this size. As long as backwards capability in design exists, we should be able to handle the modular upgrades to items such as software and obsolete hardware.
data.integration: Unable to define and track the G/R handoffs, I do not believe we have all the correct personnel engaged for this activity since none of the Product IPT PSIs have been involved in the IRRs.
